summary.text: Reneé Pack is a Democratic state representative from Indiana House District 92 who has represented the district since 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a U.S. Army veteran and business executive.

paragraphs.text: Pack was born in Nashville, Tennessee, lives in Wayne Township, Indiana, and graduated from Whites Creek Comprehensive High School in 1980.

She served in the U.S. Army from 1986 to 1991, and she earned a bachelor's degree in business administration and management from Indiana Wesleyan University and a master's degree in educational leadership from Indiana University-Purdue University Indianapolis.

Her career experience includes working as a behavioral specialist with Fitzsimmons Army Medical Center, as a business operator and as a parent and community liaison with the Metropolitan School District of Wayne Township.
She took office in the Indiana House on November 4, 2020, succeeding Karlee Macer.
